tools.name: pick_random_number
tools.description: Pick a random whole number in an inclusive range, like spinning a "pick a number" wheel. Defaults to 1-100.

tools.name: search_wheels
tools.description: Search publicly shared name-picker wheels already created on spinwheelnames.com by title or description (e.g. "classroom", "baby names", "raffle"). Returns links a user can open to view or reuse an existing wheel.

tools.name: get_wheel
tools.description: Fetch a specific saved wheel from spinwheelnames.com by its slug or id, including its entries and description, and show it as an interactive wheel the user can spin.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
